notes.text: The $14.99 PAVILIA throw is a candidate, with mixed shedding feedback (E04). I’m comparing soft lighting via IKEA FADO (E05), next checking the full cost and bulb requirements. No direction dropped.

FADO plus warm-white bulbs totals $34.98 before tax/shipping (E06, E10), just below IKEA’s $35 delivery minimum. I’ve dropped the cool-white bulb (E08) and will compare a simpler lamp with lighting included.

Selected the larger $19.99 throw (E15), building on E04’s care and review evidence. Dropped lamp exploration because of bulb and delivery complications (E06–E12). Research complete; nothing purchased.
